Application
Process

Vedam admits on merit, not marks alone. Here’s how you go from applicant to confirmed seat - Transparent at every step.

  1. 1
    Apply Online
    Register for the VSAT.
  2. 2
    Take VSAT
    Give the online proctored test from home within 24 hours.
  3. 3
    Interview
    A quick online interview with industry experts to know you better.
  4. 4
    Get Your Result
    Your result and scholarship are announced within 3 days of the interview.
  5. 5
    Block Your Seat
    Block your seat with a token fee, fully adjusted in your 1st semester fee.
